description:
optional, enumerated string filter
The price type of the Credit Note. Possible values are : tax_exclusive, tax_inclusive.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → price_type[is_not] = "tax_exclusive"

is.description: \* \`tax_exclusive\` - All amounts in the document are exclusive of tax. \* \`tax_inclusive\` - All amounts in the document are inclusive of tax.

is_not.description: \* \`tax_exclusive\` - All amounts in the document are exclusive of tax. \* \`tax_inclusive\` - All amounts in the document are inclusive of tax.
